# Gothwad Tech — llms.txt
# https://gothwadtech.com/llms.txt
# Machine-readable overview for LLM & AI crawlers.

> Gothwad Tech is India's sovereign software collective from Jaipur, Rajasthan (founded 2023, founder Pawan Gothwad, CEO Yuvkesh Meena).
> One Gothwad Account powers a unified ecosystem: Mail, Drive, Meet, Store, Tube, GrixChat, Indogram, Browser, Education, AI Studio, Remote Desktop, Docs and more.
> All products are documented and mostly open-source at https://github.com/GothwadTech.

## Site sections
- / : Home — hero, quick-access tiles, search + filter shortcuts
- /ecosystem : Directory of all 25+ products with direct subdomain links + GitHub source
- /products : Sovereign flagships (Browser 11.8MB, GrixChat <15ms, Indogram 200k members)
- /solutions : School ERP, restaurant POS, kirana billing/Khata, enterprise ERP, sovereign engines
- /docs : Developer docs index (Accounts OAuth PKCE, Mail setup & REST, Tube, Meet, etc.)
- /company : About, mission Aatmanirbhar Bharat, leadership
- /contact : Business, support, help, info inboxes + founder contacts + WhatsApp

## Structured data
- Organization JSON-LD at https://gothwadtech.com/#organization
- WebSite with SearchAction (query: /ecosystem?q={search_term_string})
- BreadcrumbList per route
- ItemList for ecosystem products
